newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt bars Brotherhood man from travelling.
newsitem.headline: Egypt bars Brotherhood man from travelling.

text.p: Egyptian security officials on Sunday barred a leading member of the outlawed Moslem Brotherhood organisation from travelling to a conference in Yemen, a witness said.

The officials stopped Ma'amoun el-Hodeibi before he was to board a plane along with 87 members of Egyptian opposition parties en route to a conference against normalising ties with Israel, the witness said.
Hodeibi is the deputy Grand Master of the Brotherhood, Egypt's largest and most influential Moslem fundamentalist group.
A spokesman at the Interior Ministry said he had no information on Hodeibi's travel ban.
Immigration officials prevented Hodeibi from leaving for Turkey in January because of a travel ban they said was issued in September 1995.
Hodeibi won an appeal against the travel ban.
The Brotherhood is technically illegal. The government once tolerated its activities but in the past two years it has arrested many members for mainly political offences.
